title: Good News at the Party
setting: A bright house party and a garden under a cloudy sky.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben, a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna, his wife with long blonde hair and a yellow dress

sentences.en: Ben and his wife Anna are at a party.
sentences.zh: 本和妻子安娜在参加一个聚会。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Anna, his wife with long blonde hair and a yellow dress arrive at a bright house party.

sentences.en: The house is busy and full of light.
sentences.zh: 屋子里很热闹，灯火通明。
sentences.scene_prompt: A crowded room with many bright lamps, Ben, a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Anna, his wife with long blonde hair and a yellow dress among the guests.

sentences.en: A lot of people talk and laugh inside.
sentences.zh: 里面有很多人在聊天说笑。
sentences.scene_prompt: Many guests stand in groups, talking and laughing in the bright room.

sentences.en: First, they look for a glass of wine.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们去找一杯葡萄酒。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Anna, his wife with long blonde hair and a yellow dress look around the crowded room for drinks.

sentences.en: They find red wine on a long table.
sentences.zh: 他们在一张长桌上找到了红葡萄酒。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Anna, his wife with long blonde hair and a yellow dress pick up glasses of red wine from a long table.

sentences.en: Ben wants to say something personal to Anna.
sentences.zh: 本想对安娜说一些私人的话。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt leans close to Anna, his wife with long blonde hair and a yellow dress and gestures toward the garden door.

sentences.en: As they walk outside, the sky is cloudy.
sentences.zh: 他们走到外面时，天空阴沉沉的。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Anna, his wife with long blonde hair and a yellow dress walk out into a garden under a grey cloudy sky.

sentences.en: Happy Anna runs to hug him by the flowers.
sentences.zh: 安娜高兴地在花丛边跑过去抱住他。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna, his wife with long blonde hair and a yellow dress runs happily to hug Ben, a young man with short brown hair and a blue shirt beside bright flowers in the garden.
